crossRefs.note: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.
He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which Yahweh has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart…
Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.
God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter…

people.name: Hophni
people.line: A corrupt priest, son of Eli.

people.name: Phinehas
people.line: Wicked son of Eli the priest

translations.web: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.
translations.bsb: And this sign shall come to you concerning your two sons Hophni and Phinehas: They will both die on the same day.
translations.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.
translations.asv: And this shall be the sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they shall die both of them.
